text:
ella_sales: Hey team, got offered a role starting Dec 20. Wanted to confirm PTO rules for new hires: do we prorate for that partial month, and can I carry any unused days into the following year? :confused:

sam_peopleops: Congrats Ella! New hires accrue from day 1 but prorated for the first month. Carryover follows the standard cap (max 80 hours carryover with manager approval). If start date is in December we usually encourage using any short notices as unpaid or schedule around launch windows.

hr-bot: QUICK REFERENCE:
```
New Hire Accrual: Begins on start date; prorated for first partial month at 1/30 of monthly accrual per day employed.
Carryover: Up to 80 hours with manager approval.
Accrual Cap: 240 hours; accrual pauses at cap.
Blackout Policy: Team-level requests vs. company-declared blackout. Company-declared blackout requires people-ops approval for exceptions.
```

nate_hiring: Also flagging that we need two interviewers for Dec 22can hiring ops ask candidates for morning slots only? If Ella has limited PTO or needs time, we can adjust schedule.

mona_ops: For Dec 22: hiring ops prefers mornings but not mandatory. If there's a team blackout declared for that week, interviews are still ok but try to avoid taking interviewers offline. For travel/holiday overlap we allow exceptions for interviews.

ella_sales: Helpful 609. One more: if I have leftover 8 hours from prior company-offered PTO, can HR convert into Redwood balance or do I need to use them before start?

sam_peopleops: Personal balances from a prior employer can't be transferred. If you negotiated a sign-on or paid time off from your previous company, that should be used with them. For Redwood balance, only hours accrued here apply.

ella_sales: Got it. I'll plan around morning interviews and submit my start paperwork. Thanks everyone! :party_popper:
